records.text: A special operations general said Gilgamesh's remains were in a remarkable state of preservation and that 'they' had the remains.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep DYD_QHMPwqM)

appearances.snippet: I talked to a special operations general who validated that, and his words were he was in a state of remarkable preservation, okay? He said they have Gilgamesh's remains.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. The statement relies on an unnamed alleged special-operations general, and searches found no authenticated interview, military record, excavation record, or independent corroboration that Gilgamesh remains were recovered and held. The hearsay cannot be verified.
